result.summary: The food delivery home screen is mostly well-formed. The clearest defects are a typo in the search placeholder and a duration pill that overlaps the image edge on the first 'Fastest near you' card. There are also some minor contrast and consistency concerns.

issues.description: The search field placeholder reads 'Restarants, dishes, groceries'. 'Restaurants' is misspelled.
issues.suggestion: Correct the placeholder text to 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries'.

issues.description: On the first 'Fastest near you' card (Green Bowl Poké), the '15–25 min' pill sits against the bottom-left edge of the image. It appears to overlap and extend slightly past the image bounds, and it looks misaligned compared with the pills on the other cards.
issues.suggestion: Give every ETA pill the same inset from the card edges and keep it fully inside the image container.

issues.description: The placeholder text, the secondary gray text (delivery fees, '25–35 min · €0 delivery · Ramen') and the inactive tab labels are light gray on a light background. Contrast is low.
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary text and inactive icon colors to meet WCAG 4.5:1 contrast.

issues.description: The heart/favorite buttons are inconsistent. The ramen card's heart has a nearly invisible dark background, while the pizza card's heart uses a semi-transparent circle at a slightly different position and size. The white icons also have weak separation from busy photos.
issues.suggestion: Use one consistent favorite button style, with the same size, position and a solid or scrim background, across all cards.
